title: fix(console-auth): a dead invitation link reads "no longer valid", and a refused invitee is told the invited address

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgP6XkfpjCfyzzG2KwQPUZfy)_
Fixes #27509

Clause-②: no (`getInvitationPreview`'s exported signature is unchanged; it now resolves `null` only for the preview door's own not-found body, which is what its documented contract already said; the new hook, notice and optional argument are on `@object-ui/app-shell`, a private package)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：未登录访客打开一个已失效（过期、已接受、已拒绝、已撤销或不存在）的邀请链接时，控制台两套登录页和注册页不再显示「Accept your invitation … Create an account and join」和注册表单，而是显示「This invitation link is no longer valid」并给出去普通登录页的链接；邀请仍有效但用别的邮箱注册被拒时，提示改为「This invitation was sent to i***@example.com. Register with that address to accept it.」。
- **为什么改**：邀请预览接口按 ADR-0138 D2 对五种失效情况统一回 404，前端把这个 404 当成「没有预览」照常画接受与注册流程，最后用「Self-registration is not open … Ask an administrator for an invitation」拒绝手握邀请链接的人。分诊裁定只改 `ui/`，不改服务端、不加错误码、文案不说「canceled」。
- **风险与回滚**：只改前端；服务端零改动。`getInvitationPreview` 只把带 `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` 正文的 404 读作「失效」，没有该路由的旧服务端回的空正文 404 现在按读取失败处理，页面保留原有通用文案，不会把有效链接说成失效。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`ui/packages/auth/src/createAuthClient.ts` 的 `getInvitationPreview`（404 判别那几行）；`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/auth/invitationArrival.tsx` 的 `useInvitationArrival` 与 `InvitationGoneNotice`；两个 RegisterPage 里传给 `RegisterForm` 的 `onError` 与 `signUpRefusalMessages` 第二参数。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/auth/__tests__/invitationGone-27509.test.tsx apps/console/src/pages/auth/__tests__/invitationGone-27509.test.tsx`，预期 10 个用例全绿。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

The signed-out preview door answers one 404 body (`RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`, "Invitation not found. It may have expired, been used, or been withdrawn.") for an unknown, expired, accepted, rejected or cancelled id (ADR-0138 D2). The client read every 404 as "no preview", so all four pages kept drawing the accept-and-register flow for a dead link, and the sign-up ended in the generic `SELF_REGISTRATION_CLOSED` text. Per the triage answer on the card, the fix lives wholly in `ui/`: no server file, no new error code, no ADR change, and the copy never says "canceled".

- **`@object-ui/auth` `getInvitationPreview`.** Resolves `null` only for a 404 whose body carries the door's `error.code` `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`. A server without the route answers 404 from better-auth's router with an EMPTY body (read from better-call 1.4.4's router, which returns a null body with status 404 for an unmatched path, and from plugin-auth's `${basePath}/*` mount, which hands better-auth's 404 back verbatim when nothing downstream answers). That 404 now rejects like any other failed read, so a page never tells a valid invitation's holder their link is dead. The exported signature and the type's JSDoc contract are unchanged; the JSDoc now names that case.
- **One rule, in `invitationArrival.tsx` (app-shell).** `useInvitationArrival(redirect)` returns `{ preview, gone, recheck }`; `gone` is true only after the door's not-found answer for the current id, never for a failed read. `useInvitationPreview` is now its `preview` and behaves as before. `InvitationGoneNotice` is the one card all four pages draw for a gone invitation: "This invitation link is no longer valid", "It may have expired, been used, or been withdrawn. Ask the person who invited you to send a new invitation.", and a "Go to sign in" link to the plain `/login` (no `redirect`).
- **The four pages.** The console's `/login` and `/register` and app-shell's `DefaultLoginPage` and `DefaultRegisterPage` draw the notice in place of the invitation header, the "Create an account and join" prompt, and the form (and, on the console login, the dev-admin row).
- **A refused invitation sign-up.** Both register pages pass `RegisterForm` an `onError` that, for `SELF_REGISTRATION_CLOSED` on an invitation redirect, re-reads the preview. The door's 404 turns the page into the notice; an answer keeps the form. `signUpRefusalMessages(t, invitation?)` takes the invitation and maps `SELF_REGISTRATION_CLOSED` to "This invitation was sent to {{email}}. Register with that address to accept it." with the masked address, or, while no preview is known, "This invitation can only be accepted with the address it was sent to. Register with that address." The same one map, not a second one.
- **i18n.** Five keys in all ten packs: `auth.login.invitationGoneTitle`, `auth.login.invitationGoneDescription`, `auth.login.invitationGoneSignIn`, `auth.register.errors.invitationSentTo`, `auth.register.errors.invitationAddressOnly`.
- `AcceptInvitationPage` is untouched: its signed-out branch only bounces to `/login?redirect=…`, and its signed-in branch already reads the invitation with the session and shows its own not-found text.

Changeset: `@object-ui/auth`, `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/console`, `@object-ui/i18n`, all patch.

## Tests

New, one per host (the console's pages and app-shell's default pages), real `AuthProvider` over a real `createAuthClient`, only `fetch` stubbed:

- `ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/__tests__/invitationGone-27509.test.tsx`
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/auth/__tests__/invitationGone-27509.test.tsx`

Each pins: the door's 404 on login shows the notice with no sign-up prompt, no email field and a `/login` link; the door's 404 on register shows the notice and no form; a live invitation keeps the prompt and the form (control); a refused sign-up on a live invitation re-reads the preview (two reads, one sign-up) and the banner reads the masked-address text, not the generic one; a refused sign-up whose re-read answers 404 turns the page into the notice.

Updated: the two `invitationPreview-26473` page files replace their "404 keeps the generic copy" case (it pinned this defect) with "a server without the route (empty-body 404) keeps the generic copy and the form"; the door's 404 moved to the 27509 files. `ui/packages/auth/src/__tests__/invitationPreview-26473.test.ts` adds: an empty-body 404 rejects with `status: 404`; a 404 with another code rejects with that code.

## Acceptance notes

- Between the page opening and the preview answering, an invitation visitor sees today's generic invitation card and form, which then turn into the notice for a gone id. Holding the whole page until the read settles would make a hanging read block sign-in, so the swap stays.
- The re-read covers `SELF_REGISTRATION_CLOSED` only. Under an `email_domain` posture a mismatched address can be refused as `EMAIL_DOMAIN_NOT_ALLOWED`, which keeps its own text.
- No assignee or reviewer is set on this PR: the maintainer's routing rule asks nobody before the seat's ACCEPT and review, so the harness's post-PR assign and review step was skipped on purpose.
